Attune 0.0.3 adds an import timeline, editable covers, and more flexible library views.

- Recently added now groups books by day and import time. New bulk imports appear together under one timestamp, with their grouping preserved across restarts. Older imports retain individual entries.
- Replace missing or incorrect covers with JPEG or PNG images from Book details. Replacements are saved in the library and applied to future reader exports, while original EPUBs remain untouched.
- Adjust gallery covers and list density with a size slider beside the gallery/list toggle. Your preference is remembered.
- Composed controls use one outer keyboard focus ring. Add from library appears only while a reader is connected.
- Checks for updates on startup and every fifteen minutes, so new releases appear without a manual check.

Packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon and Intel, Windows x64, and Linux x64. USB Kindle support remains experimental; physical-device behavior has not been validated on every platform. macOS downloads are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. See INSTALL.txt for installation requirements and signing details.
